result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with continuous sidewalks and parallel parking on both sides. The narrow street geometry naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds, but the high density of parked cars creates significant visual obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.
